<b>Burning Bugs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are vocal, six-legged, hooded fanatics who learnt to call and guide the scorching [[Wisp]]s in the [[Wisp Thicket]].<ref>Burning Bug Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Many-legged insect fanatically obsessed with flame. These ones somehow learnt to call and guide the scorching Wisps that share their thicket."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Burning Bugs naturally wander, pausing frequently; they walk slowly until they reach an edge or a wall, at which point they turn around.<br>
The 3 Burning Bugs around the middle to right half of the Wisp Thicket are accompanied by 2 Wisps, which will constantly follow them and alert the Burning Bug of Hornet's presence if she gets in the Wisps' detection range. The 2 Burning Bugs in the left half will both Teleport in on either side of Hornet once she reaches a certain point, and they will begin their attack from there.
Burning Bugs often slowly walk forwards between attacks, and have 3 different moves once Hornet is in their vicinity:
* <b>Wisp Summon:</b> Raises its staff and summons 2 Wisps with an incantation, with a short delay between each Wisp.
* <b>Staff Rush:</b> Runs at Hornet for a set distance whilst waving its staff at her, dealing {{Damage|2|type=Fire}} with the staff. Only used if Hornet is close enough to them. This move cannot be used twice in a row.
* <b>Teleport:</b> Disappears into a haze of harmless fire, then reappears a moment later in the same fashion, often on the opposite side of Hornet. They will also use this move to pursue her if she attempts to flee.
** If knocked off a ledge, they will immediately teleport away before they can fall.

A few seconds after dying, Burning Bugs' corpses explode into flames, dealing {{Damage|2|type=Fire}}, and disappear.

After [[Father of the Flame]] has been defeated, Burning Bugs will have no Wisps following them and will be standing in place, catatonic.<br>
Once Hornet comes near, they will awaken and immediately begin to focus whilst cackling for 4 seconds, before combusting into 3 Wisps which all attack at once, as opposed to on a delay. The combustion deals {{Damage|2|type=Fire}}. Once a Burning Bug has self-immolated, they are gone forever and will never respawn in that spot. They cannot be killed during their self-immolation.<br>

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
|columns=2
|* Father, father!
* Sear us, scold us!
* All is fire!
* Fire is all!
}}

== Location ==
Five Burning Bugs can be found throughout the Wisp Thicket. After defeating [[Father of the Flame]], they permanently disappear after their self-immolation is triggered.

== Trivia ==
*The 1.0.27535 and 1.0.27776 versions of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch respectively, which are older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), have different journal notes from Hornet:<ref>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GaNLkTTszFKFv55DZj3Iw1hTUi6gbstSR56WXizrMAI Silksong Switch full text] on Google Docs</ref>
:"<i>These ones somehow learnt mastery over the scorching Wisps that share their thicket. They can summon and command them at will.</i>"
* A Burning Bug is seen in [[Greymoor]] alongside other [[Moorbugs]] in the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>
* In a concept sketch, a Burning Bug can be seen holding a staff that resembles the [[Nightmare Lantern]].
